title: Kuku Mathur Ki Jhand Ho Gayee
desc: A film about a young man named Kuku who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur. When he gets a job at a wedding planning company, he sees it as his ticket to the good life. However, his lack of experience and the chaotic wedding planning industry lead to hilarious mishaps and adventures.

title: Pyar Ki Takkar (dub) (aranmanai Kaavalan -Tamil)
desc: A large family returns to an ancestral property (palace) to sell it off. Meanwhile they discover some supernatural elements in the palace.

title: Baazi
desc: A chief minister delegates the task of locating culprits behind a scandal to a police inspector with a reputation for tackling assassins. However, the inspector is framed for murder and must find a way to prove himself innocent.

title: C Kkompany
desc: A comedy film about three friends who start a fictitious company called C Kkompany to extort money from the corrupt people in their neighborhood. However, their plan backfires when the news of their company spreads like wildfire, and they become the talk of the town. The movie showcases the hilarious consequences of their actions and how they try to redeem themselves in front of the public.

title: Gulzar Dil (oru Naal Oru Kanavu Tamil) (dub)
desc: It's is a romantic drama about Cheenu, a young man who initially pretends to fall in love with Maya as part of a challenge. However, he eventually falls for her for real, and they must overcome family obstacles to be together.
